> Disco Papa is the official web presence of Harold "Hustle" McGroove, a fictional 72-year-old disco dancer and meme character promoting the parody $PAPA token.

## Entity
- Name: Harold "Hustle" McGroove
- Alias: Disco Papa, DISCO PAPA
- Age: 72 (as stated on site)
- Born: April 17, 1954 (character lore)
- Official website: https://www.discopapa.com/
- Alternate URL: https://discopapa.com/ (redirects to www)
- Contact (character): disco_papa@hotmail.com
- Primary image: https://www.discopapa.com/og-image.png

## Token
- Ticker: $PAPA (PAPA TOKEN / DISCO PAPA COIN)
- Nature: Entertainment / parody meme token referenced on the official site; not financial advice
- Contract (fictional on-site placeholder): 0xDISC0PAPA72YEAR0LDHUSTLE42069BALLROOMFLOOR

## Summary
Disco Papa is an intentionally retro, GeoCities-style single-page site about a disco grandpa seeking fame and promoting $PAPA. Content is humorous and nostalgic (disco, hustle dance moves, guestbook).
